PhaseChart.description:
Declared phase parameters. A research coordinate for similarity weighting, never the simulator plate phase.

Bin weights for a phase at chart angle a: w_b proportional to exp(kappa * cos(phi_b - a)), phi_b = 2 pi b / bins,
then bins below floor * max(w) are dropped and the rest renormalised to sum 1.

concentration.description: von Mises kappa. 0 ignores phase entirely; large values separate phases.
concentration.title: Concentration

direction.description: ccw adds angles, cw subtracts them.
direction.title: Direction

floor.description: Drop bins whose weight is below floor x the largest bin (sparsity).
floor.title: Floor
